column1: # System requirements per edition/version, read by bin/check-dependencies (via lib/versions.sh).
# Columns are tab-separated. Comment lines start with `#` and blank lines are ignored.
# `version` is a boundary-aware prefix: "2.4.9" matches 2.4.9 and 2.4.9-p1 but not 2.4.91,
# "1" matches 1.3.1 but not 10.0.0. Rows are matched top-to-bottom, first match wins, so keep
# more specific prefixes above less specific ones (ex. mage-os 1.0 above mage-os 1).
# other     recommended version; when several are listed (comma separated) the first is the minimum
#   - Adobe Commerce, values for the latest patch of each line:
#   - Mage-OS: https://mage-os.org/get-started/system-requirements/ and the php constraint of
#   - Gaps (EOL Magento lines, Mage-OS 1.x/2.x services) from markshust/docker-magento compose/lib/versions.tsv
